summary: Idaho Copper Corp filed an 8-K reporting the closing of an underwritten public offering of 3,712,000 shares of common stock and accompanying warrants at a public offering price of $4.85 per unit, for total gross proceeds of approximately $18 million, with net proceeds of ~$16 million. The offering was made under an S-1 registration statement. ThinkEquity acted as underwriter. Proceeds will fund a preliminary economic assessment, prefeasibility study, and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change is involved.
